title: Switching trace from a bad restriction
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign coordinates, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction whose restricted formula has decision-tree depth at least $k+1$. The trace construction assigns to $\rho$ a switching trace of index $k+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates
$\rho$ is a restriction with restricted decision-tree depth at least $k+1$
